evals.expected_output: Horizon from the CircleCI image of PR 8964 running with PostgreSQL; user told the URL, the port, and admin/admin.
assertions: Horizon container built from the PR 8964 CI image (opennms/horizon:ci-455741 or compose project horizon-pr-8964) is running at the end
